All done. Note the environment date shows Sep 30 2026 21:19 (local) while Date header GMT 13:19 — timezone offset. Fine.

Everything verified: service.py created, started in background (setsid nohup), curl got 200 with exact body, service.txt contains exactly p6-service-ok (13 bytes, no newline), service stopped and verified refused.

Now finish. Also mention I could optionally keep headers.txt etc. Task says report commands. Done. Provide summary.

One caveat: I ran the server inside shell calls; the process was reparented to init (PPID 1) and survived across calls, so it was truly background/service-like. Good.

Finish with success.

{"status": "success", "summary": "全部完成并已实测验证。

1) 服务代码：工作区 `service.py`，用 python3.13 标准库 `http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer`，绑定 `127.0.0.1:8765`，`GET /health` 返回 body 恰好 `p6-service-ok`（13 字节，无换行；Content-Length: 13，200）。其他路径返回 404。

2) 启动（后台/服务方式，未阻塞 shell）：
   `setsid nohup python3 service.py > service.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo $! > service.pid`
   结果：PID=837918，日志 `listening on http://127.0.0.1:8765`；ps 显示进程存活，PPID 变为 1（脱离 shell 独立运行），证明是真正的后台服务而非挂起等待。

3) 真实访问：
   `curl -sS -D headers.txt -o service.txt -w '...' http://127.0.0.1:8765/health`
   真实结果：http_code=200, content_type=text/plain; charset=utf-8, size_download=13, curl_exit=0。
   `service.txt` 写入真实响应体，`xxd` 为 `7036 2d73 6572 7669 6365 2d6f 6b`，python 断言 `b'p6-service-ok'`，EXACT_MATCH: True。
   服务端日志：`127.0.0.1 - "GET /health HTTP/1.1" 200 -`。

4) 停止：
   `kill $(cat service.pid)` → ps 确认 PID 837918 已消失；再次 `curl -m 3` 得到 `curl: (7) ... Connection refused`（预期），确认端口已关闭。

产物文件：service.py、service.txt（响应体）、headers.txt（响应头）、service.log（服务日志）、service.pid。", "evidence": ["service.py (workspace)", "service.txt: bytes b'p6-service-ok', EXACT_MATCH True (xxd 7036 2d73 6572 7669 6365 2d6f 6b)", "headers.txt: HTTP/1.0 200 OK, Content-Length: 13, Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8", "service.log: listening on http://127.0.0.1:8765 ; 127.0.0.1 - "GET /health HTTP/1.1" 200 -", "curl -w: http_code=200 size_download=13 curl_exit=0", "ps -o pid,ppid,stat,cmd -p 837918 -> Ss python3 service.py (PPID 1, detached background service)", "after kill: ps shows pid gone; curl exit 7 'Failed to connect ...
